sn21.4:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro navo bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto vihāraṃ pavisitvā appossukko tuṇhībhūto saṅkasāyati, na bhikkhūnaṃ veyyāvaccaṃ karoti cīvarakārasamaye.
sn21.4:1.3: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn21.4:1.4: “idha bhante, aññataro navo bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto vihāraṃ pavisitvā appossukko tuṇhībhūto saṅkasāyati. na bhikkhūnaṃ veyyāvaccaṃ karoti cīvarakārasamaye”ti.
sn21.4:2.1: atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi,
sn21.4:2.2: “ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu mama vacanena taṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantehi, satthā taṃ āvuso āmantetī”ti.
sn21.4:2.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissutvā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca:
sn21.4:2.5: evamāvusoti kho so bhikkhu tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho taṃ bhikkhuṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
sn21.4:2.6: “saccaṃ kira tvaṃ bhikkhu, pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto vihāraṃ pavisitvā appossukko tuṇhībhūto saṃkasāyasi, na bhikkhūnaṃ veyyāvaccaṃ karosi cīvarakārasamayeti?
sn21.4:2.7: ahampi kho bhante, sakaṃ kiccaṃ karomīti.
sn21.4:3.1: atha kho bhagavā tassa bhikkhuno cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya bhikkhū āmantesi:
sn21.4:3.2: mā kho tumhe bhikkhave, etassa bhikkhuno ujjhāyittha.
sn21.4:3.3: eso kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī. yassa catthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
sn21.4:4.2: idaṃ vatvā sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā:
